```python
from seedemu import Emulator, Base, Routing, Ebgp, Ibgp, Ospf, WebService
from seedemu.layers import InternetExchange, PeerRelationship
from seedemu.services import WebServer
from seedemu.core import createAutonomousSystem, createHost, makeTransitAs, makeStubAs, make_real_as, enableRemoteAccess, addPrivatePeering, addRsPeer

# Create the emulator and layers
emu = Emulator()
base = Base()
routing = Routing()
ebgp = Ebgp()
ibgp = Ibgp()
ospf = Ospf()
web = WebService()

# Create Internet Exchanges with custom display names
ix1 = InternetExchange(1)
ix1.setDisplayName("IX Frankfurt")
ix2 = InternetExchange(2)
ix2.setDisplayName("IX Amsterdam")
ix3 = InternetExchange(3)
ix3.setDisplayName("IX London")
base.addInternetExchange(ix1)
base.addInternetExchange(ix2)
base.addInternetExchange(ix3)

# Create Transit Autonomous Systems
transit_as1 = makeTransitAs(100, "TransitAS-100")
transit_as2 = makeTransitAs(200, "TransitAS-200")
base.addAutonomousSystem(transit_as1)
base.addAutonomousSystem(transit_as2)

# Create single-homed stub Autonomous Systems with various services
stub_as1 = makeStubAs(101, "StubAS-101")
stub_as2 = makeStubAs(102, "StubAS-102")
stub_as3 = makeStubAs(103, "StubAS-103")
base.addAutonomousSystem(stub_as1)
base.addAutonomousSystem(stub_as2)
base.addAutonomousSystem(stub_as3)

# Add web servers to stub ASes
web.addService(WebServer(asn=101, name="web1"))
web.addService(WebServer(asn=102, name="web2"))
web.addService(WebServer(asn=103, name="web3"))

# Connect ASes to Internet Exchanges
base.joinInternetExchange(100, 1)
base.joinInternetExchange(200, 2)
base.joinInternetExchange(101, 1)
base.joinInternetExchange(102, 2)
base.joinInternetExchange(103, 3)

# Add a host with a customized IP address to one of the Autonomous Systems
host_custom = createHost("custom-host")
host_custom.setAddress("10.10.10.10")
base.addHost(101, host_custom)

# Create a real-world Autonomous System
real_as = make_real_as(64512, "RealWorldAS")
base.addAutonomousSystem(real_as)
base.joinInternetExchange(64512, 3)

# Enable remote access to one of the AS's network
enableRemoteAccess(base, 101)

# Set up peering via a route server (IX1 as example)
addRsPeer(base, 100, 1)
addRsPeer(base, 101, 1)

# Set up private peering with different peer relationships
addPrivatePeering(base, 100, 200, PeerRelationship.PEER)
addPrivatePeering(base, 100, 101, PeerRelationship.CUSTOMER)
addPrivatePeering(base, 200, 102, PeerRelationship.PROVIDER)

# Add all layers to the emulator
emu.addLayer(base)
emu.addLayer(routing)
emu.addLayer(ebgp)
emu.addLayer(ibgp)
emu.addLayer(ospf)
emu.addLayer(web)

# Save the emulator to a component file
emu.save("my_emulation_component.bin")

# Render and compile the emulator
emu.render()
emu.compile()
```
